page: Microsoft Azure EC16eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. The system runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, providing virtualization with dedicated CPU allocation.

This server configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. For local storage, the instance is equipped with a 945 GB local disk and supports Premium Storage. No dedicated graphics processing units are included in this configuration, and it does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the EC16eds_v6 offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside bundled local storage, making it suitable for workloads requiring significant memory capacity and fast local disk access without the overhead of external storage. Appropriate workloads for this hardware profile include relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and data analytics tasks.
